description: Exact simple accrued interest (notional * rate * day-count fraction) between two dates. Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD; rate is the annual rate as a decimal (0.05 = 5%). Deterministic.

convention.description: Day-count convention, e.g. ACT/ACT ISDA or 30/360.

endIsTermination.description: 30E/360 ISDA only: true if the end date is the instrument's maturity date.

rate.description: Annual rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.05 for 5%.

start.description: ISO calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2024-03-15). Zero-padded, no time or timezone.

name: accrued_interest

accruedInterest.description: Accrued interest in the notional's currency units.

title: Accrued interest
